killedBy: startGameWith: the start boundary (issue #428) campaign-new lands on level one and writes the run exactly once
why: Replaces the run record without replacing its tally, so the new campaign's end screen reports the previous campaign's numbers on top of its own. The pairing is a convention rather than something the type system enforces -- run.ts is a pure key-value store that deliberately knows nothing about statistics -- so nothing but this test holds the two `startNewRun`/`startRun` call sites together. An earlier version wrapped the call in `if (false)` and left a dangling statement the suite could not even collect; deleting the line is the mutation a real revert would make. Pinned at the START BOUNDARY, which is a different call site from the in-session New Game button's: an earlier version of this entry was declared against a test driving `hud.newGame()` and SURVIVED, because that path reaches a different `startNewRun` altogether. Three call sites, and each needs its own net.
